ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Show`; the self-loop is delayed.
`speed > 10 ? 10 : speed` reads as `speed > (10 ? 10 : speed)`. `10 ? 10 : speed` is 10 (10 is not zero, so it counts as true), so the whole expression is `speed > 10`: false, which is stored as 0.
`speed > 10` is true, stored as 1. The cap of 10 never appears.
